name: Hyperswitch (Juspay)

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED from primary docs. Outgoing merchant webhooks carry `x-webhook-signature-512` — HMAC-SHA512 — with `x-webhook-signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256) available as a fallback for stacks that cannot do SHA-512. NOTE the deviation: every other provider in PagoKit is SHA-256; a generator that hardcodes SHA-256 produces a verifier that silently rejects every Hyperswitch event. notes: Apache-2.0 payment orchestration in Rust, self-hostable, 200+ connectors. It is the only credible answer to the question PagoKit implicitly raises every time it generates a provider-specific integration: 'what happens when I outgrow this provider or need a fallback when it goes down?' Adding it lets PagoKit generate an abstraction layer instead of another lock-in.
SDKs: Official Node, Python, PHP, Rust, Java and .NET API clients, plus Hyperswitch Web/React/mobile SDKs. Docker/Helm/CDK for self-hosting.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.

Overlaps: Overlaps primer, gr4vy, spreedly (all skipped — sales-led). Sits ABOVE stripe/adyen/checkout_com rather than beside them; PagoKit needs an orchestration `layer` concept for this row to make sense.
